programme.title: The Driver's Seat
programme.desc: Lise, a mentally unbalanced middle-aged woman, travels from her home in Copenhagen to Rome, Italy where she embarks on a fatal destiny, a premeditated search for someone, anyone, with whom she can form a dangerous liaison.

programme.title: Fear and Desire
programme.desc: After their airplane crashes behind enemy lines, four soldiers must survive and try to find a way back to their battalion. However, when they come across a local peasant girl the horrors of war quickly become apparent.

programme.title: The Lady Refuses
programme.desc: A wealthy London nobleman hires a pretty but poor young woman to distract his playboy son from marrying a golddigger. Complications ensue when the girl and the father begin to fall for each other, and things get even more complicated when the son declares his love for her, too.

programme.title: Edith
programme.desc: Edith' explores how we move on from bereavements. How we make peace with our past and find something worth living for.

programme.title: It's a Joke, Son!
programme.desc: Claghorn gets into some financial difficulties and is forced by a machine-political gang to enter a race for state senator against his wife (Una Merkel) who appears to have a good chance to beat the political hack backed by the machine. Claghorn is in to siphon votes and ensure his wife's opponent will win and is expected to run a campaign that will defeat himself and his wife. But, he runs to win and the machine's henchies abduct him.

programme.title: Daughters, Wives and a Mother
programme.desc: Tashiro coincidentally meets his best friend Sugimoto in a bar very close to the apartment in which Sugimoto's wayward wife is found dead. Although Tashiro is not a suspect in the police investigation, he is racked with guilt and confesses to his wife, Masako. In an effort to further relieve his tortured sense of guilt, he then confesses to Sugimoto. Neither his wife nor his friend can believe that he could have been involved.

programme.title: Scarlet Street
programme.desc: A banned box-office hit, Scarlet Street is one of Fritz Lang's greatest American films. Middle-aged cashier Chris Cross rescues streetwise Kitty and tumbles into a spiral of desire, deception, and revenge. As his obsession grows, Chris is seduced, degraded, and transformed, while fate delivers a grimly ironic justice. Featuring standout performances by Joan Bennett and Dan Duryea, the film is packed with sharp twists and masterful direction—a classic, pitch-dark gem of film noir.

programme.title: Renegade Girl
programme.desc: Ann Shelby, whose family is allied with the notorious William Quantrill, turns outlaw to revenge herself on a renegade Indian who killed her brother.

programme.title: Captain Kidd
programme.desc: Cutthroat pirate William Kidd captures Admiral Blayne's treasure ship and hides the bounty in a cave. Three years later, Kidd, posing as a respectable merchant captain, offers his services to the King of England. Seeking a social position, Kidd also negotiates for Blayne's title and lands, provided he can prove Blayne was associated with piracy. Launched upon his royal mission, Kidd is unaware that Blayne's son Adam is among the crew, determined to clear his father's name.

programme.title: The End of Summer
programme.desc: The family of an older man who runs a small sake brewery become concerned with his finances and his health after they discover him visiting an old mistress from his youth.

programme.title: 'Neath the Arizona Skies
programme.desc: Chris Morrell, the guardian of half-Indian girl Nina, is helping her find her missing white father. so she can cash in on her late mother's oil lease. Outlaw Sam Black is after the girl and her father as well. Besides dealing with the Black gang, Morrell has to find another robber, Jim Moore, who switches clothes with him after he finds Chris unconscious from a fight with Sam Black. Along the way, he meets a lady who's the sister of Jim Moore, another bad hombre who's in cahoots with Jim Moore, and an old friend who takes in Nina and helps Chris locate Nina's father and fight off the various desperadoes

programme.title: Please Murder Me
programme.desc: A lawyer tries to exact justice on a woman he defended in court -- a woman whom he found out was guilty after getting her off.

programme.title: Brides
programme.desc: Nutsa lives with her two small children in suburb of Tblissi, Georgia. With her Goga, they would bee today a regular family if he hadn't been arrested. Between the wedding in prison and the monthly visits, a routine sets in. Wil they be able to overcome this double reality?

programme.title: Tokyo Twilight
programme.desc: Two sisters find out the existence of their long-lost mother, but the younger cannot take the truth of being abandoned as a child.

programme.title: The Ape
programme.desc: Dr. Bernard Adrian is a kindly scientist who seeks to cure a young woman's polio. He needs human spinal fluid to complete the formula for his experimental serum. Meanwhile, a vicious circus ape has broken out of its cage, and is terrorizing the townspeople. Can there be a connection?

programme.title: Jack London
programme.desc: Episodes in adventurous life of the American novelist.

programme.title: The Phantom of 42nd Street
programme.desc: A theatre critic (Dave O'Brien) teams up with a cop (Jack Mulhall) to investigate the murder of a Broadway actor.

programme.title: The Phantom of 42nd Street
programme.desc: A theatre critic (Dave O'Brien) teams up with a cop (Jack Mulhall) to investigate the murder of a Broadway actor.

programme.title: Love Laughs at Andy Hardy
programme.desc: Andy Hardy goes to college after serving in the war and finds his sweetheart is engaged to someone else.

programme.title: Till the Clouds Roll By
programme.desc: Songwriter and Broadway pioneer Jerome Kern is unable to find immediate success in the U.S. He sought recognition abroad. He journeyed to England where his dreams of success became real and where he met his future wife Eva Leale.

programme.title: Guerrero
programme.desc: In the depths of the Sierra of Guerrero in Mexico, after the disappearance of the 43 students, we find the reaction of wounded civil society to seek an answer to the situation of abuse of authority mixed with poverty.

programme.title: The Terror of Tiny Town
programme.desc: Using a conventional Western story with an all dwarf cast, the filmmakers were able to showcase gags such as cowboys entering the local saloon by walking under the swinging doors, and pint-sized cowboys galloping around on Shetland ponies while roping calves.

programme.title: Went the Day Well?
programme.desc: The quiet village of Bramley End is taken over by German troops posing as Royal Engineers. Their task is to disrupt England's radar network in preparation for a full scale German invasion. Once the villagers discover the true identity of the troops, they do whatever they can to thwart the Nazis plans.

programme.title: Sixty Glorious Years
programme.desc: Picking up where Victoria the Great (1937) left off, this sequel to the 1937 film has Anna Neagle return to the role of Queen Victoria in another colorful account of the revered British monarch's reign.

programme.title: Bella Vista
programme.desc: A film about place and belonging.

programme.title: Trapped
programme.desc: Secret Service agents make a deal with a counterfeiting inmate to be released on early parole if he will help them recover some bogus moneymaking plates, but he plans to double cross them.

programme.title: The Passionate Plumber
programme.desc: Paris plumber Elmer Tuttle is enlisted by socialite Patricia Alden to help make her lover Tony Lagorce jealous. With the help of his friend Julius J. McCracken and through the high society contacts he has made through Patricia, Elmer hopes to find financing for his latest invention, a pistol with a range-finding light. Comic complications ensue when Elmer's effort to interest a military leader is misconstrued as an assassination attempt.

programme.title: Hitler: Beast of Berlin
programme.desc: Hans Memling, a young intellectual, patriotic German, is secretly opposed to the Nazi regime. With the aid of Gustav Schultz, Father Pommer, Anna Wahl and others, he is gleaning accurate information from foreign radio broadcasts and distributing it through Germany with an underground-press operation.

programme.title: John Wayne Stagecoach Run
programme.desc: John Wayne explodes across the screen in this action-packed tale of deceit _ and revenge. In a dilapidated ghost town, John Blair (Wayne) runs afoul of the villainous Drake who attempts to cheat him out of a lucrative mail delivery contract. It all leads to a thrilling race in the gorgeous Sacramento Valley. Stagecoach Run has been beautifully restored and is in color for the very first time!

programme.title: Father's Little Dividend
programme.desc: Newly married Kay Dunstan announces that she and her husband are having a baby, leaving her father to come to grips with the fact that he will soon be a granddad.

programme.title: Hit and Run

The car was driven by the wife of a company president who is having an affair. The woman's husband manages to buy silence about the incident, but the victim's mother discovers the identity of the driver. After she secures a job in the home of the company president and his philandering spouse, the woman plans to murder the couple's son when he reaches the age of her late son.

programme.title: John Wayne Cold Vengeance
programme.desc: John Wayne burns up the screen in this thrilling tale of vengeance in the Wild West. When his father is gunned down by bandits, John Mason (Wayne) hatches a plot to catch the killer. Little does he know the killer has plans of his own! Featuring a thrilling gun battle with famed Wayne collaborator Yakima Canutt, Cold Vengeance has been beautifully restored and is in color for the very first time.

When it is discovered that the plunge was not an accident, the building's residents come under suspicion. Soon, the body count begins to mount as three more murders occur by strangulation.

programme.title: Yemen - Kids and the War
programme.desc: It is an exceptional documentary, filmed in a country no camera can penetrate _ a world exclusive. In a context in which the biggest international networks are unable to present images of this forgotten war, the Yemeni director Khadija Al Salami has entrusted her camera to 3 children who become war correspondents for this documentary in Yemen. Ahmed is 11, Rima is 8 and Youssef is 9. It is them who will recount the daily life of theYemeni people under Saudi airstrikes. They meet other kids, collecting the testimonies of wounded children in hospital and those who lost their parents in the airstrikes. With the innocence of children, they also interview adults _ a painter, a rapper, a model who has become "Miss War" on social media _ and ask them to send a message to those who they believe are the only ones who can stop the war _ the EuropeanUnion. Constructed like a story tale, with no images of violence, this deeply moving documentary shows the cruel reality of war through the eyes of children, and the incredible hope that they place in Europe to put an end to the conflict.

programme.title: The Solomon Treasures
programme.desc: The discovery in Jerusalem in 2007 of a tomb said to belong to the family of Jesus of Nazareth is just the latest in a long line of extraordinary finds which have recently come to light in the Holy Land. But not all these finds are quite what they seem. Both a stone tablet said to come from the Temple of Solomon, and an ossuary apparently belonging to the brother of Jesus, have been declared fakes. The official investigation then uncovered dozens of other fakes, and attention eventually focussed on one of the most revered objects in Israel: the ivory pomegranate. This artefact has been in the Israel Museum for nearly twenty years. Like the stone tablet, it too was linked to the Temple of Solomon _ and astonishingly it too, investigators concluded, was fake. As forensic scientists now turn their attention to the ossuaries from the 'Jesus family tomb', Israeli archaeologists are left fearing that history and science is being repeatedly distorted, and they face a challenge to separate fact from fiction.

programme.title: Unstoppable: The Fentanyl Epidemic
programme.desc: Canadians' attention has been briefly grabbed by the headline: the story an abnormally high number of overdose deaths caused by a drug called fentanyl. It merited a few days attention and then was pushed off the stage by other concerns. What Canadians failed to appreciate was that those few headlines offered a foreboding glimpse of what might be one of the most destructive waves of illegal drugs to hit North America since Pablo Escobar flooded the continent with cheap and powerful cocaine. Fentanyl is a killer. And fentanyl isn't just preying on the addict population of this country. Its victims are also Canada's unsuspecting middle-class. And the epidemic is showing no signs of letting up. In fact all signs point to the death count rising as more and more powerful versions of this drug seep into the country.The result, Canadians have no idea what's "slouching" towards them in the near future. Through the eyes of four insiders in the fentanyl industry, Dam Builder Productions will take the audience inside this world in way that will enlighten, outrage, and even fascinate.

programme.title: Remote Control War
programme.desc: The current campaigns in Iraq and Afghanistan are the world's first Robotic War, with over 7,000 robots in the air and 12,000 on the ground. Warfare has been revolutionised in a monumental shift. Mankind's five thousand year monopoly on war is breaking down. Robotic war is here.

programme.title: Trouble in Lemur Land
programme.desc: High up in the mountains of north-eastern Madagascar lives one of the world's most critically endangered primates. There are less than a thousand Silky Sifakas alive today and this area of remote rainforest, known as Marojejy-Anjanaharibe-Sud, is their only home.In the past, the rugged terrain here kept the Silkies relatively safe but things are now changing at an alarming pace. This magical place is under serious threat from illegal logging operations as international demand for highly sought-after rosewood and ebony increases. Unscrupulous logging gangs are encroaching on the Silkies' last remaining habitat."Trouble in Lemur Land" follows two men, an American primatologist and a Malagasy conservationist, on their quest to protect this rare species, at the same time providing a rare glimpse into the life of this extraordinarily beautiful and graceful animal.The film centres around the arrival of two babies in the group _ a glimmer of hope in an otherwise desperate situation. Lemur reproduction rates are slow and Silkies only mate one day in the year, so it is a very special moment when primatologist Erik Patel sees the newborns for the first time. programme.title: Mefloquine
programme.desc: Developed by the US Army after Vietnam to combat malaria in troops, Mefloquine became available to the public in the 90s. However, in the following decades it became most well-known for reports of its serious psychiatric side effects. Questions about why it has been so widely and easily dispensed have been raised for some time. The director's personal investigation seeks to understand why those affected have been left in the dark for so long. In doing so he uncovers some surprising truths about the powerful players involved in this controversial drug's story.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: O Say can you see? We're in Baltimore, MD. We'll learn about the Battle of Baltimore at Fort McHenry and the inspiration of the Star Spangled Banner. Then we dig deep into the history of Baltimore's most famous resident, Edgar Allan Poe. We'll sift through a huge collection of pop art and collectibles at the Geppi Museum, and learn about cracking codes at the National Cryptology museum.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: Snow is a fascinating world of crystals that animals, plants, and humans have had to adapt to, in order to benefit from its best and survive its worst attributes. Some communities live with Tornadoes by building homes with survival features and rather than get out of their paths, they rely on warning systems and classifications. And behind all great weather events is Wind, find out how and why it can change from a gentle breeze into a devastating gale force and where does it go? Nature's force can be mystical and puzzling and the Sunshower has been the subject of myths and legends and superstitions, but it does have a scientific explanation.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: What is La Nina and how is it being monitored? Find out the effects and the reach that this system is influencing. How did Indian Summer get its name and what is the science behind the phenomenon? Winter is the season that has the biggest effect on the planet, animal behaviour and often brings out the worst that nature can bring. Nature's Halo is a magical sight with a scientific explanation. The story of and lessons from Hurricane Katrina give us a great understanding of the ferocity and speed that nature can unleash

programme.desc: Ray Mears explores the Great Barrier Reef starting on the Queensland mainland taking a boat out to Hervey Bay with whale expert Wally Franklin. They witness a mother hump back whale teaching her three month old calf the whale moves needed to survive the long migration to Antarctica.He flies out to Lady Elliot Island at the southernmost tip of the Great Barrier Reef where he goes scuba diving on the coral reef and discovers giant turtles and manta rays and shoals of big eyed trevelly fish.Back on the island Ray helps marine biologist Maggie O'Neal plant a Pisonia tree and finds out how the Pisonia trees kill the Black Noddy bird's that nest in them in order to use their corpses as a fertile compost given the unforgiving ground of a coral island.

programme.title: Music Voyager
programme.desc: Music Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series (television/cable, broadband, in-flight and mobile) that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He's on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don't have to. Along the way, he's rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

programme.title: Show Me Where You Live
programme.desc: Show me where you live is a documentary series that aims to answer the following question: How can human beings claim ownership to a space so that they can live safely within it, function as a society, and above all be in harmony with the environment around them? As we discover cultures and emblematic populations, we follow Philippe Simay who is at the heart of Inhabiting the World and represents its identity and originality. Philippe takes us on an epic adventure around the Human Habitat and sets the tone for the journey. As a humanist and philosopher, Philippe is a tireless surveyor of the city, and an explorer of living spaces. Determined to travel around the world, Philippe unveils how the populations that he encounters claim the space they occupy, shapes it and adjust to it.

Bill tells Mumbai's rich history is told through two of its most famous inhabitants, Gandhi and Kipling. We delve into the community of the Parsi faith and learn about their beliefs regarding the circle of life before heading to a little bit of heaven on earth, the coastal paradise of Goa. This hot spot for "in the know" travelers feature white, sandy beaches and is surrounded by tropical plant life. Bill introduces both the armchair and actual traveler to this incredible destination. We explore the Portuguese influence on Goa's architecture and cuisine, tour the ghost city of Old Goa and explore Roman Catholic churches.

programme.desc: Nicknamed the Garden of Eden, this volcanic caldera is home to over 25,000 big game animals. Here survival isn't just a game—it's a matter of life and death. programme.title: Dream Journey
programme.desc: February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Not only was it the first time I ventured out to Central America, but also the first time I seriously pushed my bravery boundaries to do a whole lot of things I'd never tried before. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help! _ No danger I'd do that again in Aberdeen), I went zip-lining over a Mexican jungle, I tried habanero-packed streetfood, (failed at that miserably), and organic tequila, (managed that better;), I climbed a Maya pyramid in the middle of a Belizean rainforest and fed hibiscus flowers to a very extravagant donkey. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people _ from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. And thanks to aaaall of that, I also got to know a little bit more about myself for visiting the most remote corners of our planet reminds you how different and yet how similar we all are. New levels of expendable income mean the wallets of the wealthy elite are helping fund this rising beauty scene and creating a market for luxury goods for shrewd businesswoman Felicity Feng. Expats from everywhere are trying to gain a foothold in this blossoming city, but can they handle its lightning speed?

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.desc: It's the biggest museum in the world…the museum of artworks stolen over the centuries and never rediscovered. These works haunt the nightmares of their owners, and occupy the days of hundreds of police officers across the world, as well as those of a handful of private agencies; no country or museum of importance can claim to have been spared. According to Interpol, art theft is the fourth largest criminal trade, after the drug trade, the weapons trade and money laundering. How could it be otherwise, when the soaring price of art propels the value of some paintings into the tens of millions of Euros? This world appears to be full of mysteries. Crime syndicates rub shoulders with petty criminals and the police care more about recovering the items than they do about arresting the perpetrators.

We go deep into Ottawa's cold war history at the Diefenbunker, as well as, explore Canada's military history at the Canadian War Museum. Then we head up the Peace Tower and take a look at the library of Parliament. Finally, we learn about Canada's first nation's tribes at the Canadian History Museum.

programme.desc: We set sail to the land of the Norseman in Oslo, Norway. We'll climb the fort walls at Akershus Fortress and discover the North and South Poles at the Fram Museum. Then, we'll unearth ancient viking ship treasures at the Viking Ship Museum, and we'll brave the open waters of the Pacific with Thor Heyerdahl at the Kon-tiki museum.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: Weather is universal and it's also Extra Terrestrial. Learn about space weather and how it can impact us on earth. Supercells are unique storms that scientists have learnt to measure into three types. Under the earth's crust, nature is extremely energetic, and we see this through the Volcano which acts as our eye into the forces beneath our feet. Learn about the purple buzzing glow called St Elmo's Fire, how it was named and were to look for it.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: The beauty, magic, and the science behind the Auroras at both ends of the earth, show them to be more than just a protective magnetic layer. The technology used to measure Wind Speed is finely calibrated with an interesting formula. The Tides remind us of our connection to the moon and our place in the solar system and are monitored for any significant change can have implications for industry, communities, and our ocean life. Earthquakes often make news headlines so how are they measured and predicted and what can we learn from them about our planet? Acid Rain is a manufactured weather event, the result of manmade industry mixing with nature to result in international treaties to lessen emissions and pollution.

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: Ray Mears journeys into the remote wilderness region of Arnhem land to the Cooper Creek Billabong. He's there during the dry season and all the wild life is concentrated into a narrow stretch of water. He comes face to face with the dominant saltwater crocodile and watches as the croc manoeuvres a dead pig down river to a secret hiding place. Ray travels into Stone Country above the Billabong where he finds a gallery of ancient Aboriginal art and joins locals Connie Nayinggul and her grandson Moses on a fishing expedition. They catch a barramundi and cook the fish in a traditional ground oven using paper bark.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: The desert of Gujarat is hardly the place one expects to encounter a lion, but in the scrub forest of the region Bill does exactly that. Join him as he tracks the lion and many less dangerous creatures from spotted deer to owls and parrots. Around the campfire at night meet the local dance group who is preserving the traditional dances of the area people. A unique experience in a unique region.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: Over the years, Bill has been able to find and film all of the great predators of India, but one—the wild Asiatic Dog or Dhole. These illusive and endangered canines have rarely been captured on camera. This is the last great wildlife challenge Bill has yet to conquer…Will he succeed?

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: Nairobi is the capital of Kenya and one of the most fascinating cities in Africa. On our visit we'll see the colonial architecture of a bygone era and the ultra-modern side of town as well. We'll learn the truth behind the "Out of Africa" story and our host gets eye-to-eye with some endangered giraffes.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: Amboseli National Park has had several years of drought so we're anxious to see if the famous elephant herds are healthy. Journeys takes to the air and ground to get a count of these incredible animals. Along the way, we visit the local Masai to see how they're adjusting to encroaching civilization and we encounter buffalo, hippos and numerous bird species that make Amboseli so special.

programme.title: Nomads
programme.desc: Respect is something all skiing athletes must have. Respect for different cultures, lifestyles and their environment.

programme.title: Nomads
programme.desc: Several of the world's best kayakers are led by South African legend, Steve Fisher, on a trip down one of the most difficult rivers in the world.

programme.title: Dream Journey
programme.desc: February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Not only was it the first time I ventured out to Central America, but also the first time I seriously pushed my bravery boundaries to do a whole lot of things I'd never tried before. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help! _ No danger I'd do that again in Aberdeen), I went zip-lining over a Mexican jungle, I tried habanero-packed streetfood, (failed at that miserably), and organic tequila, (managed that better;), I climbed a Maya pyramid in the middle of a Belizean rainforest and fed hibiscus flowers to a very extravagant donkey. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people _ from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. And thanks to aaaall of that, I also got to know a little bit more about myself for visiting the most remote corners of our planet reminds you how different and yet how similar we all are. I'm looking forward to sharing my incredible experience in 5 exciting episodes of our travel series, which really turned out to be a Dream Journey:) I sim

programme.title: Of Boats And Men
programme.desc: Travelling by boat bears a priceless sense of Freedom and offers endless new vistas to all passengers. Across waterways around the world Boats are an essential tool of daily life whether they carry goods, serve as utilities or services in remote areas.

programme.title: Blue Realm
programme.desc: Whale Sharks: Gentle Giants introduces us to this amazing creature through scientists who are racing against time to save the species. Utilizing space-age technology from NASA and the Hubble Telescope, researchers are able to identify, catalogue and track individual sharks. In Mexico and remote Western Australia, whale shark tourism has proven to be both a blessing and a curse, as more and more boats vie for fewer animals. The program also features the remarkable story of shark cowboys who captured and transported 4 live whale sharks (in customized jumbo jets) to the Georgia Aquarium in Atlanta.

programme.title: Blue World
programme.desc: In the series pilot, host Jonathan Bird travels to the Bahamas, where diver interactions with Tiger sharks have become up close and personal. These large and dangerous animals are not only being hand-fed, but actually handled by divers. Jonathan learns how to flip a Tiger shark from experienced shark handlers. Next, Jonathan investigates the Crystal Cave of Abaco, Bahamas…considered the most highly-ornamented underwater cave in the world!

programme.title: Blue World
programme.desc: Jonathan travels to Iceland to investigate a giant crack in the ground filled with frigid runoff from melting glaciers. It's rumored to be the clearest water in the world. Next, he heads down to sunny Florida, not to dive a coral reef or a spectacular shipwreck, but to dive in shallow, murky water under a busy bridge. This secret spot is home to some of the ocean's most remarkable, and weird, animals.

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: Federica the turtle has arrived from Italy after a run in with a container ship. Loro Parque's offered to be her 'forever home', but how will she go sharing her new digs with others? You've heard of a fish out of water _ try a turtle!Esmeralda the iguana has a lumpy belly and Jorge the vet is worried. He's hoping it's a bounty of eggs but knows he shouldn't count his iguanas before they hatch. Its fingers crossed for some scaly babies!

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: Rafa, the 'Birdman of Loro Parque', proudly leads the Foundation's ornithological work, surrounded daily by parrots, puffins, and penguins. Meanwhile, Inaki faces a challenge: training Sue-Anne the anteater. Armed with vanilla yoghurt and patience, he's hoping charm wins over stubbornness. Will she cooperate or snub his efforts?

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: The mighty grizzly bear. The tiny powerful ant. The lunging inimitable crocodile. The indestructible rhino beetle. The hammering mantis shrimp. Which is the strongest of them all? Grizzly Bear _ North America's sub-alpine lands are ruled by its mightiest resident. Ants _ With 12,000+ species, ants are fierce, territorial defenders, dispatching intruders with ease. Crocodile _ Ancient rulers of rivers, crocodiles have the strongest bite force ever recorded. Rhino Beetle _ This forest dweller can lift 850 times its own weight. Mantis Shrimp _ With bizarre eyes and a punch as strong as a .22 bullet, it's a tiny powerhouse.

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: The explosive sprinting Cheetah. The mighty bounding kangaroo. The horned and leaping wildebeest. The powerful and sure footed horse. Or the quick footed pronghorn. Which is the fastest over land? Cheetah _ On Africa's savannahs, predator and prey race at breathtaking speeds. Pronghorn _ North America's fastest, it sustains 60 km/h and can reach nearly 100. Wildebeest _ Iconic endurance runners; calves walk within minutes and run within days. Kangaroo _ Australia's largest marsupial, alert and powerful, built for speed. Brumby _ Wild horses, symbols of strength and freedom, gallop unbridled across Australia.

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: Deserts are dry, extreme places with little rain and few plants. Semi-deserts support more life, but survival is still tough. Animals adapt to heat and water scarcity—some drink rarely, get moisture from food, or travel far for water. Many seek shade, burrow, or are nocturnal. Scorpions, ancient and armored, use pincers and venom to survive. Rattlesnakes, fast and deadly, are feared—except by roadrunners, who hunt them. Desert life demands resilience, cleverness, and unique adaptations

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: Nature's battletanks—elephants, rhinos, and hippos—dominate Africa. Elephants survive on plants, yet lions and hyenas target the weak. Despite their gentle image, elephants have killed rhinos in brutal clashes. Rhinos, around for 6 million years, are tough but endangered—man is their greatest threat. Hippos are aggressive and feared, even by crocodiles. But baby hippos are vulnerable if they stray from their mothers, making them targets for predators. In the Race of Life, strength and strategy are key to survival.

programme.title: Africa's Deadliest
programme.desc: Masters of stealth or speed, using enhanced senses and lethal strategies to hunt, Africa's killers include the incredibly fast cheetah and lions, which while slower, have raw power and ingenious teamwork on their side. The rivers, meanwhile, hold fearsome crocodiles.

programme.title: Creative Killers
programme.desc: Across Africa, predators use the land to amplify their hunting skills. In Ndutu, cheetahs rely on speed and lookout points, even using fawns as bait. Lions, heavier and slower, depend on cover—gullies, marshes, forests—for ambushes. As the wildebeest migration arrives, we follow three characters through the rainy season, watching calves grow and predators adapt. The film explores how these hunters use the landscape, passing knowledge from one generation to the next.

programme.title: Speed Kills
programme.desc: There's more than just one creature lurking in this black lagoon. Here, in this bizarre netherworld between river and ocean, evolution has created a variety of freakish assassins, many of whom can strike in the blink of an eye. Witness the fast-paced, deadly action up close and in slow motion as our high-speed cameras capture sharp-shooting archerfish, African fish eagles, mantis shrimp, and other killers at work. Cutting-edge CGI details show just how they use their alien jaws, spear-like arms, and color-changing skin as weapons of underwater war.

programme.title: Blue Realm
programme.desc: Sharks are BIG business in adrenaline eco-tourism. And some thrill seekers deliberately pursue close encounters with deadly sharks _ without the protection of a cage. The bigger and more dangerous the shark, the better. Shark advocates Dr. Erich Ritter and Chuck Anderson have grave reservations about how far we are willing to go for a thrill. And they have intimate knowledge of the subject. Both men were brutally attacked by bull sharks. Shark Divers also examines the controversy surrounding a handful of high-profile attacks in 2008, including the first shark tourist killed while on a shark excursion.

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: Ubongo the gorilla has a foot injury, and treating a 400-pound patient takes serious skill. Meanwhile, Ester's team unveils a coral farm—less cuddly, but just as vital. And in the summer heat, Hugo the sloth cools off with a slow-motion shower. From veterinary challenges to marine innovation and quirky animal moments, Loro Parque never stops surprising.

programme.desc: The R.I.P. team visits the former home of the last woman hanged for witchcraft in Virginia and encounters the spirit of the still fiercely protective foreman of her farm.

programme.title: Rip Files

programme.title: The Past Hunters
programme.desc: The former home of Queen Victoria is now home to many spirits who have been seen by guests and staff. Witness the first ever formal documentation of the paranormal activities in the Bulkeley Hotel.

programme.title: What In the World
programme.desc: Presented by Peadar King, this series illustrates the human consequences of global economic inequalities and human rights violations, by focusing on how people encounter these issues on a daily basis.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: Get your kicks on Route 66 in Flagstaff, AZ. Duck and cover! We're headed to the famous Barringer meteor crater outside of town. Then we scan the stars for heavenly bodies at Lowell Observatory. We'll learn the history of the region at the Northern Arizona History Museum, and finally swing from their many ponderosa pines at Flagstaff Extreme adventure park.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: We're headed upstate to Albany and Saratoga Springs. We'll take the Albany capital tour and see five former NY governors who would become US Presidents. Then, we'll board the USS Slater and see how America defended its fleet against German U-boats in WWII. We'll sample the mineral water in Saratoga Springs, and bet the farm at their famous thoroughbred raceway. Then, we'll learn how important the Battle of Saratoga was for America's future at Saratoga battlefield.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: Journey inside Dust Storms to see how they are formed and the hazards and effects they cause. A glimpse into the science of Clouds and how they fit into the weather cycle of the planet. The power of Lightening is more than visual, it is noise, electricity and it even helps plants to grow. Did you know that Rain droplets have different shapes and temperatures, it's maybe more interesting than you think?

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: Heatwaves have caused cities to literally meltdown and systems to fail, how are we working with nature's heat? When two Cyclones collide, we get the Fujiwhara Effect, how is this possible and how does it manifest? Floods occur around the world and the world is learning how to cope, combat and prevent damage and share lessons. How do you classify a Blizzard, and let's look at some of the worst blizzards that have occurred on earth. Do you really know how to measure Rainfall and how to identify violent rain from a shower or appreciate when we have had enough or too much?

programme.title: Big Coast
programme.desc: Humpback Whales, perfect water, summer sunshine and one of the finest fishing Chinook Salmon solo fishing days!

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: In Victoria just south west of Melbourne in the You Yangs National Park Ray Mears meets up with researcher Janine Duffy in a dry eucalyptus forest. They go in search of koalas and find a young male who nervously tries to establish his own territory.Ray moves down to the open grasslands and tracks a mob of Eastern Grey kangaroos. He visits the Mount Rothwell Conservation Reserve and meets an unusual marsupial _ a predator _ that is almost extinct on the mainland of Australia _ a Tiger Quoll _ smaller relative of the Tasmanian Devil. Finally Ray journeys through a Wet Eucalyptus forest to Lake Elizabeth and canoeing across the quiet waters finds himself surrounded by rare and unique duck billed platypuses

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: Just north of India is a land steeped in mystery—Nepal. Bill tours the city of Kathmandu, visits the World Heritage temple complexes, and walks along the city streets, where ancient and modern vie for space. We fly around Mount Everest, arguably the world's most famous mountain, before heading into Chitwan National Park. In Chitwan, Bill searches for tigers from the back of an elephant and observes the myriad of wildlife that call the park home.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: There is no figure in Indian history that rivals Gandhi. Bill explores the land Gandhi called home and in the process, learns about the man himself. But Ahmedabad is more than Gandhi…its rich history and unusual architecture is revealed.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: This is definitely the land of the elephant. Large herds of pachyderms roam this marshy park putting on a show for whoever wants to watch. But that's not the only big boys of this park—buffalo, lion and a host of hoofed game make this a wonder to behold.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: This under-visited, and far western Kenyan park area, is renowned for its giant flamingo gatherings that literally turn lakes pink. We explore these many parks on foot, in a safari vehicle and on horseback searching out the local legends that have marked this region the death zone. Our host faces imminent doom in three unique parks in this fast-paced episode.

programme.title: New Frontier
programme.desc: As scientists and astronomers peer closer at nearby stars with ever more fidelity they are discovering planets; exo planets, worlds outside our own solar system. With technological advances and improved techniques scientists are discovering more and more worlds every day. With confidence scientists now calculated there could be as many as 40 billion Earth like planets in our Milky Way galaxy alone.

programme.title: New Frontier
programme.desc: The night sky is a time machine. The further we look out into the universe the further back in time we reach. What we see in the night sky is only a small percentage of the contents of the Universe, most is dark matter and dark energy we know it exists; however its nature eludes us for the moment.

programme.title: Everyday Elements
programme.desc: A series that puts chemistry in our everyday experience by showing the living connection we have with the chemicals and elements that make up our world. The matter that built skies and seas, the atoms that make up you and me, the chemistry around us that forms the things we touch, smell and see. This series shows us what the objects in our universe and in our homes are made from and why the particles around us behave as they do. Everything around us is built from Everyday Elements.

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: It's cheesy and and eaten all over the world! You'll learn how Dominick's pizza became Domino's pizza. And we all know how going to a circus wouldn't be complete without fluffy sweet cotton candy! We'll explain how this feathery goodness Spun to life! And all the spy action heroes use them, but where did the term gadget really come from?

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: Take a trip to the Jersey Shore and learn how one of its famous boardwalks helped to inspire the iconic board game of Monopoly. And how did a donkey and an elephant become associated with politics? Plus, what's the difference between top grain leather and full grain leather?

programme.title: Water: H2O Stories
programme.desc: Water: H2O Stories is a 3x52 series revisiting the story of water on planet Earth and its disrupted course over time which has led to the 21st century biggest challenge.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see, how we can live in space and what science tells us about the past and the future as we journey inside out of space.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: What is La Nina and how is it being monitored? Find out the effects and the reach that this system is influencing. How did Indian Summer get its name and what is the science behind the phenomenon? Winter is the season that has the biggest effect on the planet, animal behaviour and often brings out the worst that nature can bring. Nature's Halo is a magical sight with a scientific explanation. The story of and lessons from Hurricane Katrina give us a great understanding of the ferocity and speed that nature can unleash

programme.title: Prijatno
programme.desc: U ovoj epizodi Lora i Stojan usrećiće sve ljubitelje doner kebaba tako što će podeliti neverovatan recept za domaći kebab. Zatim će spremiti keks kolač sa maskarponeom, čokoladom i karamelom.

programme.title: Dejvid Roko: Domaći slatkiši
programme.desc: Poslednjih godina, mnogi su prestali da putuju, pa i Dejvid Roko. Njega i porodicu su hrana i kuvanje zbližili. Dejvid sada otvara svoj dom i poziva porodicu i prijatelje da podele svoju priču o tome šta hrana znači za njih.

programme.title: Rik Stajn: Mediteranski izleti
programme.desc: Rik nastavlja svoje putovanje po Siciliji, uživajući u bojama i ambijentu riblje pijace Katanije. Rik zatim putuje u Apuliju u kontinentalnoj Italiji, gde su lokalna jela inspirisana viševekovnim siromaštvom.

programme.title: Pol Holivud: Kulinarsko putovanje kroz Meksiko
programme.desc: Nakon što je proveo prvih nedelju dana u Meksiko Sitiju, Pol kreće na putovanje da bi obišao što je više moguće. Prvo odlazi u Donju Kaliforniju, koja je stekla ugled zbog svoje vrhunske hrane. Dobija poziv na "Quinceanera" proslavu, i donosi tortu.

programme.title: Nadijini prosti začini
programme.desc: U ovoj seriji Nadija demistifikuje kuvanje sa začinima, pokazujući kako se lako njima jelo uzdiže do izvanrednog. Sa samo osam začina ona stvara fina jela za svaku priliku. Videćemo i da se začini koriste ne samo zbog ukusa već i zbog mirisa i boje.

programme.title: Luk Nuen: Vijetnam
programme.desc: U prvoj epizodi serijala Luk Nuen istražuje hranu i upoznaje ljude koji žive u gradu Hue, gde su u 17. veku živeli vladari Vijetnama. Voditelj odlazi u razgledanje istorije i kulture ovog živopisnog grada i priprema ražnjiće s limunskom travom.

programme.title: Luk Nuen: Vijetnam
programme.desc: U drugoj epizodi serijala Luk dolazi u Dong Hoj i priprema jelo za jednu porodicu. Nakon tri sata vožnje Luk stiže u Vin i istražuje lokalne pijace. Kasnije mu u pomoć priskaču lokalci i zajedno pripremaju jegulju na roštilju i svinjski vrat.

programme.desc: Vrhunski kuvar Tom Keridž kreće na put u svom kamionu-kuhinji iz 1950-ih kako bi istražio najudaljenije uglove Britanije. Upoznaće proizvođače, poljoprivrednike i ribare koji obezbeđuju hranu, i kuvaće koliko god može sa sastojcima koje pronađe.

programme.title: Dezerter
programme.desc: Neočekivano prijateljstvo u konfuznoj i haotičnoj situaciji. Sajmon Mari bori se za francusku Legiju stranaca. Paskal Dipon bori se samo za sebe. Ljudi u ratu preispituju čast, nadu i moral. Jer, od svega se može pobeći, osim od sebe.

programme.title: Ubistvo predsednika srednje škole
programme.desc: U katoličkoj srednjoj školi, popularna devojka udružuje se s novinarkom iz drugog razreda kako bi istražile slučaj ukradenih SAT ispita. Kada dvojac usmeri sumnje prema osumnjičenima, otkriva se mnogo veća zavera.

programme.title: Vrisak 4
programme.desc: Režirana od strane Vesa Krejvena, ova uzbudljiva horor filmska serija iz 1990-ih nastavlja se novim poglavljem. Najprodavaniji pisac Sidni Preskot (Neve Kembel) vraća se u Vudzboro, ponovno se sastajući sa šerifom Djuijem (Dejvid Arket) i Gejl (Kortni Koks-Arket). Međutim, Sidnijev dolazak se podudara sa ponovnim pojavljivanjem ubice Duhovne maske, stavljajući sve, uključujući Sidnij, Gejl, Djuija i njenog rođaka Džil (Ema Roberts), u ozbiljnu opasnost.

programme.title: Noćna tabla
programme.desc: Uživajte uz "Noćnu tablu" _ dinamičan informativno-zabavni magazin.

programme.title: Družina iz šugar krika: Tajno sklonište
programme.desc: Četvrti nastavak iz serijala "Družina iz Šugar Krika". Družina juri kroz močvaru, ali nailaze na prethodno neistraženu teritoriju, koja ih vodi usred misterije. Kao da to nije dosta, Poetrino jagnje izaziva haos u školi, pa su zbog njega svi u nevolji kod gđice Lili. Kad se sve smiri, družina planira da noć provede u pećini nadomak groblja, ali Tom Til otkriva tajnu koja će ih sve uzdrmati.

programme.title: Skor: Mjuzikl na ledu
programme.desc: Sedamnaestogodišnji Farli je vodio bezbedan život: školovan kod kuće, jeo organsku hranu i posećivao umetničke galerije. Na zaprepašćenje svojih roditelja, Farli voli da igra hokej sa decom iz komšiluka. Stvar je dodatno zakomplikovana kada ga primeti vlasnik omladinskog tima, koji ga odmah uzima pod svoje i on postaje zvezda. Ali brzo otkriva da slava ima cenu, uključujući i očekivanje da se bori na ledu. Kad se tome doda kvarenje odnosa s najboljim prijateljem, Farli shvata da ništa ne ide kako bi trebalo.

programme.title: Deca bez granica
programme.desc: Ešton, Selest i Beka su troje neobičnih srednjoškolskih autsajdera koji formiraju klub u napuštenom pozorištu. Tamo upoznaju Čarlija (Bil Kobs), beskućnika koji deli njihovu ljubav prema muzičkom pozorištu. Kada saznaju za plan da se pozorište sruši, tinejdžeri pokušavaju da ga spasu modernom izvedbom Šekspirovog komada "Mnogo buke ni oko čega". Tokom pripreme predstave, deca uče da se prema drugima odnose s poštovanjem i da se bore za svoja uverenja. U filmu igra i Li Meriveder, nominovana za Zlatni globus.

programme.title: Penina senka
programme.desc: Tokom odmora na ostrvu Ejmland, devojka otkriva opasnog konja koji nema poverenja u ljude. Da bi dokazala da konj uopšte nije opasan, devojka ga potajno obučava kako bi ponovo stekao poverenje u ljude.

programme.title: Maraton
programme.desc: Mladi službenik Jusuf predlaže četvorici kolega iz firme da učestvuju na maratonu i pronalazi sponzora. Oni pristaju, pa Jusuf postaje njihov trener. Ispostavlja se da je čitav trening klatak cirkus. Fizičko stanje muškaraca, koji su pušači, pijandure, žderači slatkiša i kockari, zaista je užasno. Uz to, ni situacija kod kuće nije im baš zavidna, jer svako ima svoje probleme. Uprkos inspirativnim treninzima trenera Jusufa, oni naizgled ne mogu da prate njegov gust raspored. Prvi test, trka u Amsterdamu, pretvara se u katastrofu. Nakon Jusufove kritike, momci postaju uporni, pa čak i fanatični. Ipak, tokom priprema za maraton, postaje jasno da je ulog mnogo veći od spasavanja garaže, kako im je rečeno.

programme.title: Visina
programme.desc: Agentu FBI ponuđeni su milioni da pomogne lopovu da pobegne iz otetog aviona.

programme.title: Poslednji ples
programme.desc: Nakon tragedije, poznata plesna kompanija iz Njujorka nalazi se na ivici kolapsa. Iako su napustili svet plesa zauvek, Travis, Krisa i Maks imaju poslednju šansu da ponovo pronađu strast i dokažu da čuda zaista mogu da se dogode.

programme.title: Ljubav u oblacima
programme.desc: Novinarka Bruklin odlazi na Festival balona da upozna pilota Džareda, koji organizuje romantične letove, iako nije baš spreman za ljubav.

programme.title: Prokleta kuća
programme.desc: U najzamršenijoj priči Agate Kristi, sumnjive okolnosti smrti bogatog starešine porodice istražuje špijun koji je postao privatni detektiv, Čarls Hejvord, koga bivša ljubavnica nagovara da pronađe ubicu svog dede pre nego što Skotland Jard razotkrije mračne porodične tajne. Na ogromnom imanju, u toksičnoj atmosferi ogorčenosti, zavisti i ljubomore, u kući zaista pokvarenih ljudi, Hejvord susreće tri generacije dinastije, uključujući pozorišnu glumicu, udovicu pedeset godina mlađu od svog supruga, kao i žensku glavu porodice, lejdi Edit de Haviland.

programme.title: Favorit
programme.desc: Geri Hart, bivši senator iz Kolorada, postaje favorit za predsedničkog kandidata ispred Demokrata 1987. godine. Njegova harizma i ideali donose mu podršku mladih, ali optužbe za vanbračnu aferu pokreću skandal koji preti da uništi i kampanju i privatni život.

programme.title: Ponoć u plavoj travi
programme.desc: FBI agent i savezni policajac iz Floride udružuju se kako bi istražili niz nerešenih ubistava.

programme.title: Na kraju sveta
programme.desc: Saravak, na severoistoku ostrva Borneo, 1839. godine. Gotovo sasvim slučajno, sultan od Bruneja postavlja britanskog avanturistu Džejmsa Bruka na poziciju radže. Kao nezavistan vladar kreće u lični krstaški pohod protiv pirata, ropstva i lova na glave, dok istovremeno pokušava da obuzda zlonamerne ekspanzionističke ambicije Britanske imperije.

programme.title: Na kraju sveta
programme.desc: Saravak, na severoistoku ostrva Borneo, 1839. godine. Gotovo sasvim slučajno, sultan od Bruneja postavlja britanskog avanturistu Džejmsa Bruka na poziciju radže. Kao nezavistan vladar kreće u lični krstaški pohod protiv pirata, ropstva i lova na glave, dok istovremeno pokušava da obuzda zlonamerne ekspanzionističke ambicije Britanske imperije.

programme.title: Arturov viski
programme.desc: Kada Džoanin muž umre, ona je šokirana otkrićem da je njegov životni rad u šupi zapravo eliksir koji vraća mladost onome ko ga pije. Podelivši ga sa dve prijateljice, tri žene kreću u ludu avanturu i osvajaju grad, ali ubrzo shvataju da nisu spremne da budu mlade u modernom svetu. Komična i dirljiva priča o nestašnim ženama koje uče da budu oprezne s onim što žele.

programme.title: Vatrom na vatru
programme.desc: Kad vatrogasac u civilu, Džeremi Kolman, slučajno prisustvuje gangsterskoj likvidaciji, pristaje da svedoči na suđenju za ubistvo. Ali kad se program za zaštitu svedoka pokaže kao beskoristan, Džeremi kreće u lov na vođu bande, kako bi zaštitio voljenu ženu.

programme.title: Savršen dan za umiranje
programme.desc: Prijatelji koji su prisustvovali užasnom zločinu pitaju se kako su preživeli i prošli bez povreda, svi osim jednog od njih. U procesu samospoznaje shvataju značaj svoje urnebesne, ali uvrnute sudbine. Dok im vreme polako ističe, šansa za iskupljenje nadohvat je ruke.

programme.title: Noćna tabla
programme.desc: Uživajte uz "Noćnu tablu" _ dinamičan informativno-zabavni magazin.

programme.title: Družina iz šugar krika: Pljačkaš iz močvare
programme.desc: Neočekivano otkriće tajne mape u močvari vodi Družinu iz Šugar Krika na ludo putovanje, avanturu u kojoj pokušavaju da nadmudre lopova u trci za skrivenim blagom.

programme.title: Izviđačka avantura
programme.desc: Film o odrastanju grupe dečaka i devojčica koji se vraćaju s kampovanja i shvataju da je njihov mali grad pod opsadom grupe prilično tupavih bajkera. Koristeći svoje izviđačko znanje, deca savladavaju članove bande, jednog po jednog.

programme.title: Ujak Nino
programme.desc: Otuđena i prilično disfunkcionalna porodica ponovo se zbližava, kada im iz Italije u Čikago u iznenadnu posetu dođe očev davno izgubljeni ujak Nino.

programme.title: Izgubljeno blago Džesija Džejmsa
programme.desc: Tim dece iz Misurija pokušava da reši sto godina staru misteriju i spasi svoje prijatelje u ovoj porodičnoj akcionoj avanturi. Duboko u drevne pećine, oni moraju da pobegnu lovcima na blago koji su im za petama, ili da budu zauvek izgubljeni.

programme.title: Deca špijuni: Sve vreme sveta
programme.desc: Novopečena penzionisana agentkinja Džesika Vilson pokušava da se prilagodi porodičnom životu, ali su joj kućni poslovi teži od bilo kakve misije. Kada porodična amajlija slučajno oslobodi opasnog Čuvara Vremena, Džesika se vraća u akciju, a deca Sesil i Rebeka, uz pomoć starih Špijunčića, postaju jedina nada za spas porodice i čitavog sveta.

programme.title: Projekat Dinosaur
programme.desc: Projekat "Dinosaurus" govori o ekspediciji oca i sina u Kongu, uz pratnju dokumentarističke TV ekipe. Kada svi akteri filma misteriozno nestanu, pronađeni snimak pokazaće zapanjujuće prizore dinosaurusa, za koje se verovalo da su izumrli pre 65 miliona godina.

programme.title: Postanje
programme.desc: Engleski prirodnjak Čarls Darvin pokušava da pronađe ravnotežu između svojih revolucionarnih teorija o evoluciji i odnosa s religioznom suprugom, čija je vera u apsolutnoj suprotnosti s njegovim životnim delom.

programme.title: Obućar
programme.desc: "Kobler" govori o obućaru, četvrtoj generaciji u porodičnom poslu, koji pronalazi magičnu šivaću mašinu u podrumu svog oca. Mašina mu omogućava da živi živote svih ljudi koji nose njegove cipele.

programme.title: Ponovo pisati
programme.desc: Oskarom nagrađeni pisac, koji je zapao u krizu, napušta Holivud i odlazi na Istočnu obalu da predaje pisanje scenarija na fakultetu. Tu se zaljubljuje u samohranu majku, studentkinju tog fakulteta.

programme.title: Brzina metka
programme.desc: Petoro plaćenih ubica u brzom vozu otkrivaju da su im misije međusobno povezane.

programme.title: U raljama zveri
programme.desc: Potraga bivšeg agenta CIA za otetom ćerkom uvlači ga u mrežu političkih spletki, korupcije, opasnosti i izdaje.

programme.title: Rezervoar
programme.desc: Nakon što je na tajanstven način nasledio napušteno imanje na obali, Ben i njegova porodica slučajno oslobađaju drevno biće koje je dugo bilo uspavano, a koje je generacijama terorisalo ceo region, uključujući i njegove pretke.

programme.title: Rezervoar
programme.desc: Nakon što je na tajanstven način nasledio napušteno imanje na obali, Ben i njegova porodica slučajno oslobađaju drevno biće koje je dugo bilo uspavano, a koje je generacijama terorisalo ceo region, uključujući i njegove pretke.

programme.title: Mučno
programme.desc: Bratsko rivalstvo prerasta u izdaju. Jedan brat je pomoćnik uspešnog, ali sumnjivog biznismena, a drugi vodeći kandidat za premijersku poziciju. Uz pruženu priliku da se osveti napaćenoj porodici, dok ga progoni psihotični policijski detektiv, naš antiheroj mora da nauči da živi u svetu u kom nikome ne sme da veruje i gde je odanost retka pojava.

programme.title: Opoziv
programme.desc: Veliki Vesli Snajps igra lovca u ovom SF ostvarenju. Petoro prijatelja odlazi na odmor u kućici na jezeru, očekujući miran vikend. Ipak, ne znaju da je Zemlja pod opsadom vanzemaljaca i da su masovne otmice u toku, što njihovu avanturu pretvara u borbu za opstanak.

programme.title: Kosmički greh
programme.desc: Sedmoro odmetnutih vojnika započinje preventivni udar na novootkrivenu vanzemaljsku civilizaciju, u nadi da će okončati međuzvezdani rat pre nego što je zapravo započeo.

programme.title: Noćna tabla
programme.desc: Uživajte uz "Noćnu tablu" _ dinamičan informativno-zabavni magazin.

programme.title: Družina iz Šugar Krika: Nevolje s učiteljem
programme.desc: Drugari iz Šugar Krika iznenada više nisu učiteljičini miljenici kada u grad dođe njena zamena, gospođa Blek. Nepravedna optužba dovešće Bila u neprijatnu situaciju s roditeljima i otvoriti mnogo više pitanja nego odgovora. Zašto gđa Blek fotografiše ljude po gradu, ko je otrovao njenog prelepog konja i da li će zaista u školi biti fizički kažnjavani?

programme.title: Vidimo se u septembru
programme.desc: "Vidimo se u septembru" je originalna romantična komedija, smeštena u moderni Menhetn. Film govori o Lizi, prelepoj ženi koja naizgled ima sve, ali se duboko u sebi plaši vezivanja. Kad sazna da će njen terapeut celog avgusta biti na odmoru, šokirana je i uplašena. Umesto da ovu vest prihvati smireno, ona traži pomoć od ogorčene prijateljice, Monike.

programme.title: Pas Timber - Lovac na blago
programme.desc: Dečak i njegov najbolji prijatelj (preslatki pas koji govori), daju sve od sebe da sačuvaju svoj dom i porodicu.

programme.title: Praktične devojke
programme.desc: Dve bogate sestre, naslednice porodičnog kozmetičkog carstva, suočavaju se sa surovom realnošću kada ih skandal i istraga ostave bez nasledstva.

programme.title: Operacija "Morski vuk"
programme.desc: U poslednjim danima Drugog svetskog rata, Nemačka, očajna i u potrazi za poslednjom šansom da porazi saveznike, okuplja svoje preostale podmornice za završnu misiju: napad na kontinentalne Sjedinjene Države.

programme.title: Kancelarija na ćošku
programme.desc: U ovoj komediji o kancelarijskom životu, savesni službenik Orson pronalazi utočište u praznoj kancelariji, daleko od napornih kolega. Međutim, njegov neobičan izbor izaziva neočekivano negodovanje i pokreće niz apsurdnih događaja.

programme.title: Zaboravljeni
programme.desc: Džordž je mentalno oboleli beskućnik, koji već godinama nije u stanju da zadrži posao. On luta gradom tražeći hranu, alkohol i sklonište, ali sve vreme pokušava da ostvari kontakt sa svojom ćerkom. Džordž se obraća njujorškoj socijalnoj službi, ali mu za potrebnu finansijsku pomoć nedostaju dokumenta. Tada postaje prijatelj s drugim beskućnikom, koji tvrdi da je bio uspešni džez muzičar.

programme.title: Isterivači duhova
programme.desc: Nakon invazije duhova na Menhetn, ljubiteljke paranormalnih pojava Erin Gilbert i Ejbi Jejts, nuklearna inženjerka Džilijan Holcman i radnica podzemne železnice, Peti Tolan, zajedno se suprotstavljaju neprijatelju s drugog sveta.

programme.title: Krvoproliće
programme.desc: Priča o srdačnom susretu četvoro roditelja, nakon tuče u školskom dvorištu između njihovih sinova.

programme.title: Na pogrešnom putu
programme.desc: Četvorica mladića upuštaju se u rizičnu investiciju, koja ih vodi u sukob s mafijom.

programme.title: Slom
programme.desc: Policajka se sa ćerkom vraća u rodni grad da brine o teško bolesnoj majci. Međutim, ubistvo mlade sugrađanke otvara istragu koju zapravo niko ne želi da vodi, pa ona ostaje duže nego što je planirala kako bi otkrila istinu.

programme.title: Igra žrtvovanja
programme.desc: Kao da već nije dovoljno loše to što učenice internata, Samanta i Klara, ne mogu da odu kući za praznike, situacija se dodatno komplikuje kada se na njihovim vratima pojavi banda ubica baš u vreme Božića.

programme.title: Skrivena Kina
programme.desc: Kina je industrijski gigant i urbani moćnik. Ali izvan poznatih slika nebodera i ogromnih gužvi, nalazi se drugačija Kina. Ovo je zemlja ekstrema _ velikih prirodnih lepota _ gde domišljati ljudi grade neobične živote, uprkos svemu. Na ovom putovanju otkrića, zaronićemo duboko u nesvakidašnji, zagonetni i skriveni svet. Upoznajemo seljake koji se drže zabačenih planina, gde uzgajaju i pripremaju čaj na isti način već 1.000 godina. Idemo u ribolov na ledu sa ribarima na granici s Rusijom, gde temperature padaju i do -40. Upoznajemo stočare velikih azijskih stepa, koji sedaju na konje od trenutka kad prohodaju. Potpuno različiti svetovi, ujedinjeni jednom temom _ domišljatošću ljudi koji moraju da opstanu u surovoj prirodi. Spremite se da uđete u skrivenu Kinu.

programme.title: Grad naturista
programme.desc: Naturističko selo Kap d'Agd ima ozloglašenu reputaciju; mediji ga uporno predstavljaju kao mesto neobuzdanih užitaka _ magnet za svingere iz celog sveta. Od skromnog naturističkog kampa braće Oltra iz pedesetih godina prošlog veka do današnjeg naselja _ raja za libertince _ ovde se odigrala nezapamćena transformacija. Ne zadržavajući se samo na podeli između naturista i libertinaca, ovaj dokumentarni film osvetljava istoriju ovog mesta i sile koje su oblikovale njegov razvoj. Film nam pomaže da razumemo ljude koji ovde borave _ bilo na jedan dan, jednu noć, nedelju dana, tokom odmora ili tokom cele godine. Naturističko selo? Libertinsko selo? Pakao? Raj? Ipak, postoji jedna reč oko koje se ovde svi slažu: sloboda.

programme.title: Operacija Barbarosa
programme.desc: Jun 1941. Nemci su nanizali seriju lakih pobeda. Opijeni svojim uspesima u Norveškoj, Holandiji, Belgiji i Francuskoj, pripremaju se da krenu u tajnu operaciju na Istoku... Pre Božića, u to su sigurni, biće ponovo kod kuće. Kako su mogli i da zamisle da će se upustiti u brutalan rat koji će odnijeti šest miliona života u samo nekoliko meseci? Akteri ove priče, i vojnici i civili, beleže ono kroz šta prolaze, kako na nemačkoj, tako i na sovjetskoj strani: u formi kratkih amaterskih filmova _ Nemci su mnogo snimali _ ali i u pismima i dnevnicima. Daleko od zvaničnih izveštaja i državne propagande, otkriva se druga strana Operacije Barbarosa, iz perspektive muškaraca i žena, vodeći nas u samo srce pakla.

programme.title: Naučne minijature
programme.desc: "Naučne minijature" je zabavna i intrigantna naučna serija koja testira znanje gledalaca o različitim naučnim temama. Privlači gledaoce iznenađujućim činjenicama, brzim kvizovima i zanimljivim mišljenjima. "Naučne minijature" koristi šest stručnjaka koji nas vode kroz različite oblasti kao što su životinje, svemir i planete.

programme.title: Supernova: Masakr na muzičkom festivalu
programme.desc: Ovaj potresni film pruža uznemirujući i detaljan prikaz masakra koji je Hamas izveo na muzičkom festivalu Supernova 7. oktobra 2023. godine. U 6:30 ujutru, teroristi Hamasa probili su granice iz Gaze u Izrael, a festival u Re'im bio je jedna od njihovih prvih meta, započinjući rat koji traje do danas. Posetioci festivala, pripadnici hitnih službi i roditelji talaca otkrivaju svoje šokantne priče o preživljavanju, neopisive strahote kojima su svedočili i njihove borbe u povratku svakodnevnom životu. Snimano samo nekoliko dana nakon događaja, njihova trauma je očigledna, tuga zbog izgubljenih prijatelja je opipljiva, a njihov strah i dalje je prisutan. Napadi su dokumentovani u realnom vremenu, po prvi put, od strane počinilaca i žrtava. Koristeći materijale pažljivo prikupljene iz desetina izvora, uključujući Hamasove kamermane i GoPro kamere, mobilne telefone preživelih, CCTV snimke, kamere u automobilima i od prvih reagovaoca na licu mesta, ovaj film pruža neviđeni uvid u masakr.

programme.title: Merilin, njena poslednja tajna
programme.desc: Montan, Miler, Kenedi: spisak Merilininih ljubavnika i muževa je dugačak i mnogima poznat. Ali jedini čovek kog Merilin Monro nikad nije uspela da nađe, iako ga je tražila celog života, bio je njen otac. Nakon više od dve godine istrage, zahvaljujući pramenu kose Merilin Monro, uspeli smo da izvučemo hromozome njene muške linije i uporedimo ih sa potomcima čoveka s kojim je u to vreme izlazila Merilinina majka. Naučna i istorijska istraga će na povesti na putovanje od SAD do Engleske, i na kraju do Francuske, podižući veo sa jedne od poslednjih tajni Merilin Monro, njenog biološkog oca.

programme.title: Špijunske misije
programme.desc: Neverovatne priče iz dosijea CIA-e, DIA-e, Mosada, MI6, ruske SVR i drugih vrhunskih obaveštajnih službi za koje niste ni znali da postoje. Oslanjajući se na nedavne uspehe kompanije Big Media sa emisijama "Umetnost špijunaže" i "CIA protiv Bin Ladena", serijal ulazi duboko u svet vodećih špijunskih agencija kako bi oživeo neverovatne tajne misije. Svaka epizoda pruža uvid ne samo na samu misiju, već i na špijune koji su ih vodili, agencije koje stoje iza njih i uloge koji su bili u igri.

programme.title: Skrivena Kina
programme.desc: Kina je industrijski gigant i urbani moćnik. Ali izvan poznatih slika nebodera i ogromnih gužvi, nalazi se drugačija Kina. Ovo je zemlja ekstrema _ velikih prirodnih lepota _ gde domišljati ljudi grade neobične živote, uprkos svemu. Na ovom putovanju otkrića, zaronićemo duboko u nesvakidašnji, zagonetni i skriveni svet. Upoznajemo seljake koji se drže zabačenih planina, gde uzgajaju i pripremaju čaj na isti način već 1.000 godina. Idemo u ribolov na ledu sa ribarima na granici s Rusijom, gde temperature padaju i do -40. Upoznajemo stočare velikih azijskih stepa, koji sedaju na konje od trenutka kad prohodaju. Potpuno različiti svetovi, ujedinjeni jednom temom _ domišljatošću ljudi koji moraju da opstanu u surovoj prirodi. Spremite se da uđete u skrivenu Kinu.

programme.title: Nevolje s Kanjeom
programme.desc: Film "Nevolje s Kanjeom" istražuje uspone i padove u životu i karijeri Kanjea Vesta, poznatog i kao Je. U oktobru 2022. godine, Je, ranije poznat kao Kanje Vest, bio je meta opšte osude nakon što je nosio majicu s natpisom "Životi belaca su bitni" na Pariskoj nedelji mode. Nakon ove kontroverze je usledio i niz antisemitskih izjava na društvenim mrežama. Pošto su njegove sporne izjave dospele u naslove novina širom sveta, Je je nastavio da deli opasne i zapaljive neistine tokom niza intervjua. Suočen sa reakcijom javnosti, Je je rekao paparacima da planira da se kandiduje za predsednika SAD na izborima 2024. Smešten u period skorašnjeg Jeovog ponašanja i navodne predsedničke kampanje, ovaj dokumentarac prati nagrađivanog novinara Mobina Azhara na putu do SAD-a, u pokušaju da otkrije kako je jedan od najslavnijih umetnika u Americi postao glasnogovornik mržnje i podela.

programme.title: Međunarodni pregovarači
programme.desc: Pregovaranje je deo svakodnevnog života svakog čoveka. Od prijateljskog cenkanja sa prodavcem voća na pijaci, do pregovora sa poslodavcem oko povišice ili snalaženja u porodičnoj krizi sa voljenom osobom _ to radimo neprestano. Ali postoji nekolicina ljudi koji nam mogu pružiti dubok uvid u finu umetnost pregovaranja, naročito onda kada su ulozi veliki. Ulazimo u umove nekih od najveštijih svetskih pregovarača kako bismo razumeli šta je potrebno da se izađe na kraj sa situacijom u kojoj jedan pogrešan potez može biti koban. Koje tajne mogu da otkriju o umetnosti pregovaranja? Proučavamo četiri situacije u kojima je ulog život ili smrt, i upoznajemo pregovarače koji su savladali umeće taktičnosti u smrtonosnim okolnostima.

programme.title: Betonski spavači
programme.desc: Nakon Drugog svetskog rata Jugoslavija i Hrvatska kao jedna od njenih republika grade novo društvo između Istoka i Zapada. Bio je to eksperiment obeležen mnogim protivrečnostima koje se odražavaju i u arhitekturi _ važnom delu tog velikog društvenog projekta. Na neobičnom putu od Zagreba do Beograda preko Zenice i Sarajeva, do malog belgijskog grada Wevelgema, kroz četiri epizode ćemo istražiti arhitekturu koja je predstavljala temeljne vrednosti tadašnjeg društva: federativnost, nesvrstanost, modernizaciju i antifašizam. Posetićemo kuće, spomenike i gradove koji su te ideje utelotvorili. Ispitaćemo sudbinu arhitekture najvišeg simboličnog značenja koja je radikalnim istorijskim rezom izgubila prvobitni smisao, ali ne kulturnu i prostornu važnost.

programme.title: Daleko od grada, život iz snova
programme.desc: Da li ste ikada sanjali o životu blizu prirode, u jednostavnim uslovima? U seriji "Daleko od grada, život iz snova" upoznaćete ljude koji upravo tako žive. Iz sezone u sezonu, ova serija je očarala norvešku televizijsku publiku. Dvadeset i dve godine nakon što je prva epizoda prikazana na NRK-u, serija i dalje ima veliku gledanost, kako na televiziji, tako i online. U seriji upoznajete širok spektar ljudi _ mlade i stare, samce, parove i porodice _ koji se suočavaju s različitim životnim dilemama. Ono što im je zajedničko je da su odlučili da žive na udaljenim mestima, često blizu prirode i u jednostavnijim uslovima, poput planinskih litica, vetrometina na ostrvu usred mora ili duboko u divljini, gde polarni medved vreba oko njihove kuće.

programme.title: Ubice snimljene na delu
programme.desc: Dokumentarna serija o istinitim zločinima sa jedinstvenim pristupom video-snimcima koji su vodili do osuđivanja ubica širom sveta. Stručnjaci objašnjavaju kako najsavremenija tehnologija gradi vizuelni mozaik dokaza.

programme.title: Greška ubice
programme.desc: Služeći se dirljivim intervjuima i dramatičnim rekonstrukcijama, emisija "Greška ubice" istražuje fatalne greške koje su na kraju vodile do hapšenja. Priča svake žrtve je ispričana pomoću toka policijske istrage, tokom kojih su detektivi gradili slučajeve od najmanjih dokaza. Mrlje krvi, snimci sa skrivenih nadzornih kamera, pogrešna reč kazana u pogrešnom trenutku... Šta od toga može da oda ubicu? To otkrivamo na kraju svake epizode koja nosi intrigu, izazov i složenu tematiku, u seriji koja je dirljiva, ali i upućuje nas u proces istrage. Sve zavisi od jednog malog dokaza... A ako se dođe do njega, ubica ostaje slobodan.

programme.title: Na mestu zločina
programme.desc: Kada se suoče sa zločinom, za istražitelje postoji samo jedno rešenje: izneti tragove na videlo! Savršen zločin ne postoji. Napad, otmica, ubistvo… osumnjičeni uvek ostavlja tragove za sobom. Kako bi privukla pažnju gledalaca, serija koristi vizuelni stil nalik seriji CSI, koji pomaže da se svaki trag bolje razume. Svaka epizoda zasnovana je na deset tragova, predstavljenih kao razbacani delovi jezive slagalice. Gledalac postepeno otkriva ulogu svakog traga u slučaju, sve dok se na kraju ne razotkrije istina. Svaka epizoda donosi uzbudljivu i fascinantnu priču koja publiku drži u neizvesnosti do samog kraja. Stvarnost je jača od fikcije!

programme.title: Ubistvo: borba za istinu
programme.desc: Heroji koji su jednostavno znali da nešto nije onako kako izgleda. Heroji koji su u svojim istragama išli korak dalje. Heroji koji su priveli ubice pravdi. Heroji koji su se borili za istinu. Kakvo je to osećanje kada su policija, sudovi, mediji, advokati, patolozi, stručnjaci i javnost, svi protiv tebe? Kada ti kažu da ono za šta znaš da je istina — nije tačno? U ovoj izuzetno emotivnoj i ličnoj seriji saznajemo kako su hrabri, odlučni i strastveni ljudi, u potrazi za pravdom, prešli granice službene dužnosti. Prateći po jedan novi slučaj u svakoj epizodi, otkrićemo kako su, uprkos svim preprekama, uz pomoć intuicije, veštine i napornog rada, otišli korak dalje i obezbedili da pravda bude zadovoljena.

programme.title: Ubica u porodici
programme.desc: Džeraldo Rivera detaljno istražuje najmračnije trenutke u životima poznatih osoba kada izgube člana porodice usled ubistva ili kada član porodice počini krajnji zločin. Epizode u trajanju od sat vremena prikazuju stvarne priče iza ovih tragedija.

programme.title: Forenzičari: Stvarni CSI
programme.desc: Više kamera u realnom vremenu prati istrage teških krivičnih dela i otkriva presudnu ulogu koju savremena forenzička nauka danas ima u privođenju kriminalaca pravdi. Prateći slučajeve od istraga silovanja do ubistava, serijal prikazuje fascinantan put pojedinačnih dokaza _ od trenutka kada su pronađeni na mestu zločina, preko detaljne mikroskopske analize u specijalizovanim laboratorijama, pa sve do otkrivanja ključnog uticaja koji ti nalazi imaju na tok svake istrage. Radeći pod stalnim pritiskom ograničenog "forenzičkog vremenskog okvira", dok se metode kriminalaca neprestano menjaju i razvijaju, ovi stručnjaci veoma dobro znaju koliko su njihovi rezultati važni. Njihov rad može odlučiti da li će nevina osoba završiti iza rešetaka ili će krivac ostati na slobodi.

programme.title: Greška ubice
programme.desc: Služeći se dirljivim intervjuima i dramatičnim rekonstrukcijama, emisija "Greška ubice" istražuje fatalne greške koje su na kraju vodile do hapšenja. programme.title: Nacisti u begu
programme.desc: U oktobru 2021, još jednom krećemo u kopanje po idiličnoj šumi Arnsberg. 77 godina nakon užasnog događaja, ekipa arheologa pokušava da povrati dostojanstvo onima koji su tu ubijeni _ nalazeći i sahranjujući poslednjih sedam žrtava. Tek tada saznaju da federalni autoput prolazi preko mesta na kom su ih ubice zakopale. Verovatno nikada neće biti nađeni. Ovaj dokumentarac prati šta se dogodilo u toj šumi u to vreme, rekonstruiše tok događaja uz pomoć inscenacija i istorijskih snimaka, dozvoljava savremenim svedocima da prvi put javno progovore i istražuje razloge zbog kojih je ubistvo 208 muškaraca, žena i dece prošlo nekažnjeno.

programme.title: Naoružavanje Arktika
programme.desc: Postavljen u nemilosrdnim predelima zaleđene pustinje, ovaj istraživački dokumentarac ispituje sukob koji tek predstoji. Kako globalne temperature rastu i arktički ledeni pokrivač se povlači, tako se otkrivaju dragoceni prirodni resursi koji nisu pod međunarodnim ugovorima. Rusija je preuzela kontrolu nad vitalnim novim morskim putevima i izgradila stotine vojnih baza na Arktiku. Kina izvodi vojne vežbe zajedno s Rusijom. A Zapad pokušava da ih sustigne, dok se na polovima iscrtavaju borbene linije. Uz insajderski pristup vojnim kretanjima NATO-a, Rusije, Kine i drugih država, ovaj neodgodiv dokumentarac istražuje tenzije u regionu i globalne posledice mogućeg sukoba.

programme.title: Špijunske misije

programme.title: Selo bez žena
programme.desc: Tri brata, Dragan, Zoran i Rodoljub, žive zajedno u Zabrđu, selu na vrhu planine, negde u južnoj Srbiji. Najveća želja im je da pronađu neveste. U obližnjim srpskim selima već su bezuspešno pokušavali da ih nađu, ali nijedna žena nije htela da dođe i živi na vrhu pustog brda. Međutim, na albanskoj strani granice, na Kosovu, nalaze se sela u kojima žive samo žene. Njihovi muškarci otišli su na rad u Grčku. Politika ne zanima braću, njima je najvažnije da reše svoje lične probleme i spremni su da se ožene Albankama. Ako dovedu albanske neveste u srpsko selo postavlja se pitanje: može li da opstane brak između neprijatelja?

programme.title: Nacisti u begu
